title: CONSIDER: A. APPROVING the Locally Preferred Alternative (LPA) for the LA River Path project as Modified Option 2, an 8-mile path between Riverside Drive…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0638, Project]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
CONSIDER: 

A.  APPROVING the Locally Preferred Alternative (LPA) for the LA River Path project as Modified Option 2, an 8-mile path between Riverside Drive and Atlantic Boulevard evaluated in the Draft Environmental Impact Report (EIR); 

B.  APPROVING an approximately 5.5-mile gap closure through two simultaneous Initial Operating Segments (IOS) - the IOS-north between Riverside Drive and Spring Street; and the IOS-South, between Sixth Street and Atlantic Boulevard; and

C.  AUTHORIZING staff to work with the City of Los Angeles to bridge the 2.5 mile gap between IOS-north and IOS-south, to prioritize planned Class IV cycle tracks, in combination with the existing on-street bike lanes, which can serve as an interim connection until funding for the off-street river channel paths between Broadway/Spring Street and Sixth Street is secured.
